name: ai-job-application-copilot
description: Production-grade AI-powered job application assistant monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @copilot/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @copilot/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @copilot/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @copilot/api
scripts.type-check: npm run build:shared && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
